Boundaries and interactions differ from isolated gravitational direct sums. note.ja: 第4象限を除いた[-1,1]²、theta∈[0,3pi/2]、u=r^(2/3)sin(2theta/3)、解析Dirichlet。N8/16/32、graded map x→x max(|x|,|y|)。正方形sin(pi x)sin(pi y)を同Nのregular/warpedで別検査。 再入隅の調和特異解を真の2D P1で解き、同じ未知数の一様/graded格子と、独立した滑らかな正方形の歪みを比較します。
note.en: L-shaped[-1,1]² minus quadrantIV, theta0..3pi/2, analytic Dirichlet harmonic corner field. N8/16/32, fixed map x→x max(|x|,|y|). Separate unit-square sine MMS uses regular/warped grids. Solve a harmonic reentrant-corner field with actual2D P1 FEM; compare matched-DOF uniform/grading and separate smooth-square mesh distortion.

name.ja: 純Neumannの互換条件と平均値ゲージ
name.en: Pure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge

note.ja: 単位正方形N16/32/64、セル中心の点DOF。cos(2pi x)cos(2pi y)、全壁Neumann0、平均0とN32の平均.25診断。 特異な2D Poissonを互換条件と指定平均込みで解き、不適合な外力を拒否します。
note.en: Unit square N16/32/64, cell-centred point DOFs, cosine exact field, homogeneous Neumann; mean0 andN32 mean.25 probe. Solve singular2D Poisson with compatibility/gauge and reject incompatible source.

name.ja: 2D混合Robinの製造解と境界流束
name.en: 2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux

note.ja: 単位正方形N16/32/64、u=cos(pi x)cos(2pi y)+x+y。x壁Neumann±1、y壁alpha1,beta.5の解析Robin。 2D PoissonのNeumann/Robin面を実際に組み、連続製造解と境界fluxを照合します。
note.en: Unit square N16/32/64; cosine-plus-linear exact field. x walls Neumann±1; y walls analytic Robin alpha1,beta.5. Assemble actual2D Neumann/Robin faces and compare the manufactured field and boundary flux.
